name: system confirmation (frozen before any result)

confirm.exclusion: every request of the training arms, the probe set and the dev set

groups.changed: a held-out task (7-12) edited and asked; answer-changing only
groups.unrelated: same request as a stable item while another task is edited

views.raw: changed section only, CAP-CPT 'previously learnt' anchor
views.closed: dependency closure: shared constants + changed section; nothing if the request's task is unchanged
views.typed: closed + a one-line note on what is updated
views.matched: constants + the request's own current section (oracle retrieval)

routing: task parsed from the explicit task_type_k; update scope from version metadata; ambiguous -> full policy

selection_on_dev.choose: passes all gates, then fewest prompt tokens
selection_on_dev.repair: only if both fail: 120-step continuation from prec, arms repair (conflict) vs consistent; prefer consistent if within 3pp

statistics: per seed and pooled seed-stratified paired bootstrap (2000); thresholds are acceptance guards, not non-inferiority proofs; token counts are not latency or cost
